pruning_output.case_id: ID of the paper or case.

task_pair_records.path_id: Paper-level path ID copied from plan.planned_id.

candidates.candidate_id: Active Task1 candidate ID. Omit this entry when Task1 is already high-quality and is not reviewed again.

candidate_snapshot.analysis_anchor: Task-specific paper analysis anchor copied from the universal schema.
candidate_snapshot.analysis_path: Task-specific analysis_path copied from the universal schema.
candidate_snapshot.method_quality: Task-specific method_quality evidence copied from the universal schema.
candidate_snapshot.analysis_code: Task-specific analysis_code copied from the universal schema.

candidates.decision_summary: Evidence-based reason for the Task1 judgment, including applicable pruning rule numbers.

estimand_alignment.note: Whether the quantity, scale, contrast, population, and time scope answer the assigned question.

variable_support.note: Whether focal variables and construction rules have authorized evidence and verified columns.

sample_audit.note: Whether exclusions are documented and code reports sample flow.

restriction_justification.note: Whether restrictions, cutoffs, transformations, outlier rules, and missing-data rules are justified.

control_justification.note: Whether every control and fixed effect has a defensible role and evidence.

focal_variable_structure.note: Whether variable structure is preserved or information loss is justified.

plan_code_consistency.note: Whether code columns and implementation match the declared path.

candidates.candidate_id: Active Task2 candidate ID. Omit this entry when Task2 is already high-quality and is not reviewed again.

candidate_snapshot.analysis_anchor: Task-specific paper analysis anchor copied from the universal schema.
candidate_snapshot.analysis_path: Task-specific analysis_path copied from the universal schema.
candidate_snapshot.method_quality: Task-specific method_quality evidence copied from the universal schema.
candidate_snapshot.analysis_code: Task-specific analysis_code copied from the universal schema.

candidates.decision_summary: Evidence-based reason for the Task2 judgment, including applicable pruning rule numbers.

restriction_justification.note: Whether restrictions, cutoffs, transformations, outlier rules, and missing-data rules are justified.

control_justification.note: Whether every control and fixed effect has a defensible role and evidence.

focal_variable_structure.note: Whether variable structure is preserved or information loss is justified.

task_pair_assessment.decision: high-quality only when both active candidates are high-quality; otherwise low-quality.
task_pair_assessment.task1_candidate_id: Selected high-quality Task1 candidate ID, or null.
task_pair_assessment.task2_candidate_id: Selected high-quality Task2 candidate ID, or null.
task_pair_assessment.reason: Reason for the combined task-pair assessment.
